seoDescription: How Umbra compares to DevUtils on price, platforms, tools, source, and privacy verification. Checked 2026-09-19.
intro: DevUtils is the established, paid, macOS-only alternative to Umbra. Here's how the two compare, checked 2026-09-19.

rows.label: Price
rows.competitor: Paid (perpetual/team licences; exact price not published on its own site as of 2026-09-19)

rows.label: Privacy verification
rows.umbra: A documented, repeatable network-monitor check you can run yourself
rows.competitor: States "everything you paste into the app never leaves your machine"; no published verification mechanism found as of 2026-09-19

verdict: DevUtils has far more tools and years of polish on a single platform — if you're macOS-only and don't mind paying, it's a mature, well-regarded choice. It makes almost the same “never leaves your machine” claim Umbra does — but asserts it once, in a sentence, rather than publishing a way to check it. Umbra is free, runs on three platforms instead of one, and ships a local AI feature DevUtils doesn't have as of this writing.
